findings.body: The `forge-source` case sets only `repo = "forge-source"`; the fixture's merge setting remains `human`. It proves that human merge stays human, but never exercises Forge's configured `agent` merge through `forge close` and `forge merge`. No other command test covers that combination, so a regression that disables agent merges in Forge's own repo would pass. Add that case to this command test.
findings.title: Not done: Forge's own agent merge test

findings.body: The plan assigns this to TALK after MERGE. `src/forge/nextstep.py:304,317` still reads the raw merge setting, so `forge next` tells a user to merge a ready unsigned prototype configured with `merge = "human"`; its cleanup path also misses `forge merge`. `src/forge/templates/skill.md:41-43` likewise tells the agent to merge only when the raw setting is `agent`. TALK must use the effective setting and test those command paths.
